chronotype.rationale: Late-chronotype genotype — peak strength, power, and reaction-time performance shifts later in the day. Avoid 06:00 sessions if performance matters; reserve early hours for low-intensity work.

cognitive.summary: BDNF Val/Val — efficient activity-dependent BDNF secretion. Strong cognitive-benefit response to aerobic exercise.
cognitive.training_note: Conventional aerobic training (3-4 ×/week, 40-60 min Zone 2) is highly effective for mood, memory, and neuroplasticity outcomes.

risks.mitigation: Favourable tendon-stiffness profile — running economy advantage.

factors: ACTN3 CT (R/X) — mixed fibre type, balanced
power_endurance.recommendation: Prioritise heavy strength (3-6 reps) and explosive work (jumps, sprints, Olympic lifts). 2-3 short conditioning sessions/week is sufficient. Avoid chronic high-volume aerobic which blunts your strength response.

factors: rs1800795 (IL6 -174) GG — high baseline inflammatory tone
recovery.protocol: Expect prolonged DOMS and slower clearance of training stress. 48-72 h between hard sessions on the same muscle group. Aggressive recovery: sleep ≥8 h, omega-3, tart cherry, contrast showers.
